caption: The segment destination port is read and matched in the socket table; port 80 goes to the web server and port 53 to DNS. The lookup uses IP plus port, not the port alone.

spec.title: Demultiplexing one arriving segment
spec.aria: A block diagram where a segment arrives from IP, its destination port is read, the socket table is searched, and the data goes either to the web server on port 80 or to the DNS process on port 53.
